subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should this PR's explicit proof lock/unlock lifetime be accepted as the synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation and canonical proof observation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but the lock boundary decides whether a canceled queued chat command is confirmed as delivered or removed locally, so owner intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after the assigned chat owner confirms that holding the proof lock through result handling preserves the intended cancellation ordering.

options.title: Tighten Lock Scope First
options.body: Ask for a small revision that unlocks immediately after proof decision, SQLite commit, and cache removal while still avoiding actor-isolated closure capture.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after the assigned chat owner confirms that holding the proof lock through result handling preserves the intended cancellation ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the live assignee and current routing point for accepting the message-delivery synchronization boundary.
